svg.title: Historical map times
svg.desc: Historical raster comparison from revision 938df92 to revision a863784. Each workload uses a separate zero-based absolute scale, with endpoints printed below its marks. Whiskers show recorded minimum and maximum, not confidence intervals. Button map · 120 × 64: previous median 0.366667 ms, range 0.310833 to 0.386667; current median 0.258333 ms, range 0.249167 to 0.3125. Panel map · 640 × 360: previous median 5.7625 ms, range 5.57083 to 6.75833; current median 2.77917 ms, range 2.64583 to 3.52917. Capsule map · 240 × 64: previous median 0.473 ms, range 0.465 to 0.485; current median 0.29 ms, range 0.278 to 0.296. Unique lens update: previous median 1.375 ms, range 1.29833 to 1.39917; current median 1.20583 ms, range 1.15333 to 1.38417. 7 paired samples/build · map scale 2. 640 raw maps checked · 0 changed bytes
